_comment: Synthetic stress-test pack #145 / option E. Entry declares modversions['temperature']=99 — intentionally drifted from the engine's pinned modversion (currently 4). Loading the pack should fire the modversion-drift signal (warning in normal mode, ManifestError in CHEMIGRAM_STRICT_MODVERSIONS=1).
